id_token.title: Id Token
id_token.description: Google ID token (or dev token in dev mode)

GoogleAuthRequest.title: GoogleAuthRequest
GoogleAuthRequest.description: Body for POST /auth/google — the Google ID token from the Android client.

ItemMergeRequest.title: ItemMergeRequest
ItemMergeRequest.description:
Collapse duplicate detections into one item.

The first id is the survivor; the rest are deleted and their media re-linked
onto it. ``quantity``/``item_name`` optionally override the survivor's values.

ItemSplitRequest.title: ItemSplitRequest
ItemSplitRequest.description:
Replace one item with several. Each part starts as a copy of the original
(media included) with the supplied fields overridden.

RejectRequest.title: RejectRequest
RejectRequest.description:
Customer's revision request — a reason is required so the surveyor knows
what to change.

SurveyItemUpdate.title: SurveyItemUpdate
SurveyItemUpdate.description: Partial update: only provided fields are changed (unset fields untouched).

SurveyStatusResponse.title: SurveyStatusResponse
SurveyStatusResponse.description: Lightweight workflow view: current status + what the caller can do next.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
Partial update for the current user's own profile.

Only fields a user may change about themselves. Role, email and account
status are intentionally excluded (changed via admin flows, not self-service).
